head: f6d8f37
mode: NEEDS_REVIEW — read-only audit, no fix executed

tasks.finding: NEW-1 — TTL wipes KillAll/NuclearCleanup confirm warning while armed state persists
tasks.current: TTL clears status_message on every non-Release key, unconditionally
tasks.fix: Exempt the TTL while app.menu_confirm_pending.is_some() (warning persists until confirm/cancel/other-selection — restores the pre-fix3 contract). Alternative: render the armed warning from menu_confirm_pending inside draw_status_bar (state-driven, TTL-immune). DO NOT disarm-on-TTL: the clear runs before dispatch, so the confirming Enter would disarm then re-arm instead of firing. Add a regression test: arm -> press Down -> Enter must either show the warning or not fire.

tasks.finding: NEW-2 — vanish notice unreadable while user is actively typing
tasks.current: notice set on the 2s tick is cleared by the next in-flight keystroke (one ~16ms frame)
tasks.fix: Make forced-drop notices sticky: e.g. a status_sticky flag set by reanchor_selection's vanish path, cleared only by an explicit dismiss (Esc) or a focus-changing key; or swallow the first post-drop keystroke (also closes most of NEW-3). Design choice for operator.

tasks.finding: NEW-3 / CA-1 residual — in-flight keystream lands on live list hotkeys after vanish-drop
tasks.current: drop to List leaves the continuing keystream live on q/x/Enter
tasks.fix: Ignore non-navigation keys for one beat (~300ms) after a forced drop, OR add the two-press confirm to list 'x' (previously declined — operator decision). Either closes the CA-1 confirm half.

tasks.finding: NEW-4 — chord-reset invariant violators (mouse both arms, Enter list->chat, 2col leak)
tasks.current: input.rs:201/204 (mouse), input.rs:1099-1106 (Enter), app.rs:1285-1292 (2col) change focus without reset_tab_chord
tasks.fix: Centralize: call reset_tab_chord() inside enter_chat_focus() and add a set_list_focus() helper used by the mouse else-arm and Enter arm; clear the chord on tab switch for the 2col leak. Makes the app.rs:1228-1232 contract true.

tasks.current: Refresh arm unconditionally sets 'Refreshed', erasing the handler's filter message
tasks.fix: Only set the 'Refreshed' ack when app.status_message.is_none() at arm entry (the TTL already cleared stale messages; a Some here means the dispatching handler set it this iteration). Preserves CA-4 (vanish notice set inside refresh still wins, it is written after).

tasks.finding: NEW-6 — mouse events never consume the TTL
tasks.current: TTL gates on Event::Key only; mouse-set notices mask git status indefinitely
tasks.fix: Also clear on MouseEventKind::Down (not Moved/Drag) — mirrors the keypress semantics.

tasks.finding: INFO-2 — '.' unlock hint wrong in chat focus
tasks.current: "Session is protected (press . to unlock)" — '.' forwards to the PTY in chat
tasks.fix: Chat-focus copy: "Session is protected (Esc, then . to unlock)".

tasks.finding: AF-4 + INFO-4 — chat_line_chars dead state + dead cmd_capture block
tasks.current: 8 write-only sites for chat_line_chars; cmd_capture block (input.rs:1680-1727) unreachable, carries stale no-chord-reset contract; onboarding copy input.rs:1103-1105 still advertises '/' commands
tasks.fix: Remove chat_line_chars, the dead capture block, and the stale '/' mention in the chat-entry hint (also part of uiux F-8) in one sweep.

tasks.finding: NEW-5 — per-tab hint masks Sessions git status on every switch
tasks.current: hint seeded on every switch into Sessions displaces git text until next keypress
tasks.fix: Skip seeding the Sessions hint after first show per run, or accept as onboarding (operator taste call).

tasks.finding: INFO-3 — empty-list phantom Chat focus bounces silently
tasks.current: vanish notice gated on if let Some(name) — None path silent; Tab enters Chat on an empty list
tasks.fix: Guard handle_tab_in_sessions on a non-empty list, or emit a generic "session ended — back to list" on the None path.

tasks.finding: AF-1 residual — Alt+Esc terminal-dependent; CA-6 residual — audit refs gitignored
tasks.current: Alt+Esc silently degrades to plain Esc on legacy ESC-ESC terminals; commit audit refs unreproducible from clone
tasks.fix: Add a double-Esc fallback chord (Esc Esc within 300ms -> literal ESC) or document the terminal requirement in Help; for future commits cite in-repo paths or inline evidence only.
